---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work, or a value doesn't match the game
labels: bug
---

**What happened**
What you did, what you expected and what you got. For a wrong value, what the game shows (a screenshot of the
character screen or the item's tooltip helps).

**Version**
The version in the window's title bar (e.g. 1.0.0), and whether you run the Windows app or from source.

**Crash log**
If the window reported an error, attach `crash.log` from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ck-dps-solver`.

**Damage type and settings**
The damage type, and whether you searched every item (and up to which biome) or only the items you own.
